intro: The courses pack: training for your staff and courses you sell to customers, built from modules and lessons, with quizzes and certificates. Switch it on in Settings › Industry packs.
start: Switch the courses pack on in Settings › Industry packs.
Make your first course on Courses, and say who can take it: staff, customers or both.
Add its modules and lessons in the builder, then publish it.
Enrol people on Learners and progress. Staff and customers can also join a published course themselves from My learning, under Join a course.

articles.title: Build a course and publish it
articles.summary: Make the course, add modules and lessons (video, reading, quiz or live session), then publish it once every lesson is ready.

steps.rest: on Courses. Give it a title and summary, say who can take it, and any price for customers. Press Make the course.
from Actions, give it a title and press Add the module.
choose its kind and press Add the lesson.
the video with its length and how much must be watched, the reading, or the quiz's pass mark. Press Save the lesson.

steps.lead: For a quiz, press Add a question
steps.rest: for each one, with its choices, the right answer and its points. Press Save the question.
from Actions to set the pass mark, retakes and the certificate it gives.
from Actions. If a lesson is not ready, the builder says what is missing.

tips: Staff invited to a draft course are enrolled when it is published.
A quiz can draw a few questions from a bigger bank, so each try is different.

articles.title: Enrol people and see how they are doing
articles.summary: Enrol staff or customers, approve places and payments, and see each learner's progress and where people stop.

steps.rest: from the course's Actions on Courses.
choose a member of staff or a customer, and press Enrol.

steps.lead: Approve a place or confirm a payment
steps.rest: from the learner's Actions, where the course asks for one.
score and when they were last here. Where people stop names the lesson most people do not get past.

tips: A customer's priced place is invoiced. Staff are never invoiced.
When a learner finishes, their certificate is given and shows on Certificates. For staff, it is added to their HR record.

articles.title: Check or revoke a certificate
articles.summary: See the certificates a course has given, check one by its verification code, or revoke one with the reason.

steps.rest: on Certificates to see who has one, their score, and when it runs out.
and press Check to see whether a certificate is real and still good.
from its Actions, say why, and press Revoke.
